six_month_mortality.notes: SUPPORT2 6-month all-cause mortality (Connors 1995; Knaus 1995 JAMA). Strict path: exclude post-admission aggregates (avtisst = TISS average across stay) and derived severity-score outputs (aps = APACHE Physiology Score, sps = SUPPORT Physiology Score). Global patterns already exclude slos/charges/totcst/totmcst/hday/dnr/dnrday and surv2m/surv6m/prg2m/prg6m (other models' output). scoma (admission GCS) and dzgroup/dzclass (baseline disease group) are kept as legitimate features.
